environment.description: Ktor 2.3.x microservice deployed on EKS with PostgreSQL 15 on RDS. The database has RLS policies defined on document_edits table using app.current_tenant session variable. However, the WebSocket endpoint accepts tenant_id as a client-supplied query parameter with no JWT/session validation. The application broadcasts edits to all WebSocket sessions subscribed to a document regardless of tenant boundary. RDS connection uses a single application role (app_user) with no connection-level tenant enforcement beyond the SET command.

config.database: PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with RLS policy on document_edits
config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON document_edits USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))
config.network: Public ALB with no WAF, WebSocket upgrade allowed
config.auth: None - tenant_id and user_id from query parameters only
